narrative.overview: A coach's sheet, not a dashboard product. Information comes first, surfaces are flat and white, and one hot accent is reserved for games, the active tab and hover. The page is a single 900px column that reads on a phone without expanding anything, with detail folded behind toggles.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with 1px hairline borders; almost no shadow.
Colour is a code (game, train, done, rest), not a mood.
Long text is clamped or collapsed by default.

rules.name: The Colour-As-Code Rule
rules.body: Coral means game, blue means training, green means done, grey means rest. Do not reuse them decoratively.

rules.name: The Small Caps Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for short labels only. Never set a sentence in uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Do not add shadows to cards to make them feel raised.

dos: Do keep the Today Card the first thing on the page.
Do keep each tile headline to about 8 words and fold the rest behind a toggle.
Do use the four state colours only for their meaning.
Do keep tap targets comfortable on a phone.
donts: Don't add nutrition or sleep UI. Both are retired.
Don't put citations, evidence tiers or program self-assessment in any rendered field.
Don't hardcode a schedule in index.html; an un-authored week must show as missing.
Don't add a webfont, framework or build step.
